europe.summary: People's Deputy and leader of the European Solidarity party Petro Poroshenko, speaking in the Verkhovna Rada, urged that heads of law enforcement agencies implicated in Carthage investigation be urgently summoned to report, noting that the lack of reforms in the rule of law hinders Ukraine's EU membership, as highlighted by the European Commission's latest Enlargement Report, the political force's website reports.
